# Brainspore Group LLC (BSG)

> Brainspore Group LLC (BSG) is a Kenya-based company providing software and IT solutions for Africa. Businesses lean on its software because it guards what it is trusted with and earns its keep every day. Its flagship solution is QSell, business management software. Also known as Brainspore, Brainspore Group, BSG and BSG LLC.

Website: https://www.brainsporellc.com
Location: Nairobi, Kenya
Email: hello@brainsporellc.com

## QSell

QSell is business management software built by Brainspore Group LLC. It runs sales, stock, finance, delivery and people in one system, and gives each business its own online storefront for customers.

## How the solutions are built

- Every move leaves a trail: what changed, who changed it, when and why is kept permanently.
- The right keys, in the right hands: access is decided on the server for every action, so information reaches only the people it is meant for.
- Tested until it holds: every feature is checked from the smallest function to the complete user journey.

## Where the solutions work

- Operations: sales, stock, purchasing, finance and people in one connected system.
- Automation: repeated manual work such as re-keying orders, chasing approvals and reconciling spreadsheets runs on its own.
- Finance: finance, inventory and operations on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, connected to other systems.
- Payments: payment collection and wallets, with M-Pesa and other payment providers.

## Founder

Paullaster Okoth (also written Paullaster Amolo Okoth) founded Brainspore and leads its engineering, with 8 years of experience building production software. Paullaster delivered the Engineers Board of Kenya membership portal, the Institution of Engineers of Kenya events and CPD portal, the National Research Fund grant management portal and the Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) staff portal.
